en: Alright, they’re gone. Now tell me why in the world you would agree to this “deal.”
I didn’t have any other choice. I was trapped in my room and the zombies were killing everyone. I had no hope of fighting back… but I swear, I didn’t know he would do this to us.
“Us.” So it’s true then. We’re both Lucretia, right?
In exchange for the powers, he asked to take half of my soul back to his home realm. I didn’t realize the other half would still be conscious, but… yeah.
Home realm, huh? Yeah, that sounds about right. I can’t believe my other half would be so stupid.
Hey! Without these powers we’d both be dead. So you’re welcome.
No, we’re still good as dead! Having your mind split in two doesn’t seem real sustainable for daily functioning, if you ask me. And there’s no way I’m just staying here.
Well what could we even do? Where would you even go?

You find Argus, and get him to undo your stupid deal. And in the meantime, I’ll try to find a way back to your realm. Maybe go to that huge statue in the distance. That looks super ominous and important, right?
Alright. Fine. I don't know how the hell I’m supposed to convince an otherworldly entity to just “undo” everything, but we don’t really have any other choice. Let’s do this.
We made a deal, Argus and I.
You’re telling me that guy – no, that monster – that just appeared, you agreed to let him do this to us?
…Yes.
So you’re the reason I’m here, trapped in this eldritch hellscape–
Well, technically, we both are–
LOOK AT WHAT YOU’VE DONE TO ME!
Aughhhh, stop shouting! My head feels like it’s being split in two!
WHY? Why would you do this?
Just give me a minute and I can explain…Shit, there’s more coming.
Ugh, you’re right. After this, you and I are gonna have a loooong chat about how to fix your mess.
Shit, you’re letting him get away!
You can’t stop this, little girl. No one can.
Stop! What has Argus told you? Why are you doing this?
If I didn’t do this, someone else would. The only way to stay on top is to squeeze out your competition.
What? It’s the end of the world, and you’re thinking about business?
You see, that’s what separates the successful from the weak: ambition. Where you see the apocalypse, I see an economic opportunity.
You’re insane.
I’m the CEO of Lake Tech & Science Co. for a reason. People like you can’t be trusted to take advantage of opportunities as they present themselves.
Says the guy that got a million dollar loan from dad…
These people are better off as mindless zombies, so I can lead them to prosperity, peace. You’ll understand soon enough. Argus did too.
There’s something that I just can’t stop thinking about…
The fact that all the zombies are totally weird and mutated now?
I- Yes. How did you know that?
I’m in your head, idiot. Which is also why, despite the fact that I’m walking through a literal swamp in an alternate dimension right now, on Earth you’re following a trail.
It looks like Argus has been doing something to the land and zombies, but how? I didn’t unleash him on our realm, I swear. That wasn’t a part of our deal.
Maybe you’re not the only one who’s been dealing with demons.
…Ah, yes, I see. Another Crawler-derived mutant strain… If my figures are correct, that means I’m nearly finished…
Holy shit, look. He’s mutating the zombies!
Argus is definitely behind this, he has to be. So what the hell are you waiting for? Kick his ass!
Oh, don’t worry. I plan to. Then we’ll get some answers.
Man, if it wasn’t for the whole eldritch-zombies and split-consciousness thing, having these powers would be awesome.  Feels good not needing to rely on anyone!
Yeah, yeah, it must be nice not being held hostage in an alternate universe. We get it. Anyways, look at what I found!
Is that cthulhu?
Well, obviously no, but it kinda looks like him. They call it an “Old One” in the painting. They seem to be worshipped like gods? And look in the corner–
Argus.
Right, but he’s not mentioned anywhere. And given how nearly everything’s covered up or destroyed, I’m guessing this was stuff he didn’t want anyone to see.
So what does it all mean?
I’m not sure. But maybe Argus has been causing chaos for longer than we realize.
I’m starting to worry this will be a lot harder than just getting him to undo the deal.
Depends how badly we care about saving the world.
See, this is why I never trust businessmen.
And suddenly I remember why we never had any friends in school. Can’t trust anybody.
Why should we? Everybody sucks and just looks out for themselves.
Listen, I agree. So explain to me why you’re trying to save the world?
Because… it’s the right thing to do? I don’t know, maybe if we can rebuild the world we can make it a better place. One where people don’t suck.
Seems like a stretch to me. Let’s just focus on finding Rohan, so he can take us to Argus and fix your mess.
Our mess. And yeah, that’s the plan. But I suspect he’s heading to the city, so it might take a while to catch up. I don’t see you doing much to help, though.
I’m doing research.
What?
I found a library. Look, there's tons of books and paintings about the people that used to live here…
Alright, well while you’re browsing, I’m gonna fight some zombies.
It’s okay, the zombies are gone now. It’s safe.
Geez, thank you so much. I thought I’d take ‘em all by myself, but I guess I overestimate my own strength sometimes.
I can’t blame you…
Alright, you’ve made your point. You’re a hero, whatever.  Let's just move on now.
Fine. Well, uh, good luck…
Name’s Ally! But, uh, you’re not just gonna leave me here, right?
Nu–uh. Nope. There’s no way in hell we’re bringing her with us. We don’t know this girl, she might be crazy! At the very least she’d slow us down.

Ally. Well, unfortunately we’ve–I’ve got something I need to take care of here and, um… I don’t think it’d be safe for you to join us. You’re better off just getting out of the city as fast as possible.
Oh… Okay. Yeah, no worries. I’ll be able to manage on my own. Probably. See ya around then, I guess!
Good. Now then, onwards to Rohan! Let’s try not to get distracted this time, alright?!
The statue is getting closer.
Hm?
The one I’ve been walking towards. I think it’ll be my ticket out of here, if I can get to it.
Be careful. I don’t even want to think about what would happen if one of us…
Yeah, yeah, just worry about yourself, okay?
We’re the same per–
AHHHHHH HELPPPPP
Did you hear that? Someone’s trapped!
What did I just say…
I see her! Up there, by the zombies!
Rohan, I’m sorry…
Do not waste your breath. T-This was my own doing… my whole life… my own doing…
Ahhh, I can’t fight these zombies much longer! There’s too many!
I-I can feel it, please, try to hold on… I need to get to Argus…
I appreciate both of your dedications, Lucretias. But please, try not to fight it. What has been done cannot be undone.
No! I will not accept this! You can’t keep me here!
Don’t worry, girls. You will realize your purpose soon enough.
Aughhhh…
Aughhhh…
Don’t worry, I got you. I got you.
I’ve made it to the statue, but it’s guarded by even more monster-zombie-things. Convenient timing, looks like we’re both in for a fight.
Yeah. Rohan is definitely here somewhere…
Talking to yourself, are you? I’m impressed you’ve managed to follow me this far… to where it all started. Tell me, what is your name?
Lucretia. I need to speak to Argus. The deals we’ve made – they’re not right. We’re destroying our world!
It’s true. With each zombie mutated and demon brought to our realm, Argus’ power grows. A new empire is coming, one with him and I on top. Why else would I have released the virus?
You can’t trust him, Rohan! Together, we can still fix this. We can undo the deals we made.
It’s too late. He’s here, and I will ascend to join him in ruling this new world, one without useless fighting and inefficiencies. Ultimate peace and order…
Well done, Mr. Moore. You’ve accomplished your end of the bargain. And now it’s time for mine. Ascension… or, mutation.
What? NOOOOOOO!
Argus!!
Okay, I think that’s the last of them.
Same here. How…
How did we do that?
You tell me. I don’t remember anything before waking up here, and I have a sneaking suspicion you have something to do with it.
Why, cause we’re connected telepathically, and sound exactly the same?
Don’t patronize me. You had that thing appear in your room just now.
Argus...
You remembered something.
Yeah, but you’re not gonna like it.
augh, I… t-the room is spinning… my head…
uuuggguuh–
–Hello?? Is someone there?
ugghh…what…w-where are you? What is the hell going on?
Up again already? Well then, I’m sure you’ll find your new powers to be most delightful. Enjoy them while you can, Lucretias!
Hey, voice in my head that sounds a lot like me – care to explain?
It’s starting to come back to me now…
Actually, let’s put a pin in it. I gotta get out of here. There’s–
–Zombies!
